author: junivaps
quote:
Its a fantastic game hands down!
I love the OG, and this one is so much more detailed and beautiful.

Sure thing they have add some new things like now u need to jump and stuff, but that dosent fkup the game! 

And sure it have some glitches,
the game run smoothly and the combat is good and not clunky at all.

This game unlocks a huge bunch of childhood memories and I love it.

Now I hope they do a remake of majora's mask and actually keep doing remakes if the old once.

This is my GOTY!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: junivaps
quote:
Well its not the same GTA at all sadly. 
It have turned to some sort of dating simulator,

They have removed everything that was fun in previous games, 

If I want to go in and robb a bank or shoot up a bar I want to have the opportunity to do so.

If I want to run over some protesters then let me, 

If I want to throw a npc to a crocodile and watch it eat the body then let me.

u cant even steal cars in ur neighborhood,
So what is this game exactly? Well its not GTA, cuz last time I played i didnt need to massage some girls feets or buy groceries, 

If I want to do so I turn off the game and do it IRL instead, 

Games are supposed to be a escape of reality, 


Anyway the story is trash and very slow phased, its more like ur watching some animated movie then playing a game, 

The graphics are pretty mid overall, nothing special at all. But its better then gta 5 atleast,

If they add all the OG gta stuff in the game it would be a easy 10/10 bit they have removed everything that was fun with gta.

Will I still play it, yes but it wont be my main game, not even close. Mby even wait a year or so and see if its get better.

I got bored pretty fast,
